task: It is your first improv class. Greet the group: say hello, your name and one thing about you.
zh: 这是你的第一节即兴课。和大家打招呼：说你好、你的名字，以及关于你的一件事。

task: The teacher says the line below very fast and you miss it. Politely ask the teacher to say it again.
say: Okay, get into groups of three, pick a leader, and the leader starts with a sound.
zh: 老师很快地说了下面这句话，你没听清。礼貌地请老师再说一遍。

task: The teacher uses a word you don't know. Ask what it means, in one short and natural question.
say: Great. Now try to bring back an idea from earlier. We call that a callback.
zh: 老师用了一个你不认识的词。用一个简短自然的问题问这个词是什么意思。

task: In a scene, you did not hear your partner's line. Ask them to say it again, but stay in character. Give two different ways to do it.
say: Mumble, mumble, the boat leaves at mumble.
zh: 在戏里，你没听清搭档的台词。请对方再说一遍，但不要出戏。给出两种不同的说法。

task: In a scene, you called your partner by the wrong name. Fix it in character, so it sounds like part of the scene.
zh: 在戏里，你叫错了搭档的名字。不出戏地纠正它，让它听起来像是剧情的一部分。

task: After a scene, give your classmate a short compliment about one specific thing they did.
zh: 一场戏结束后，针对同学做的一件具体的事，给一句简短的称赞。

task: Your mind goes blank in the middle of a scene. Say three short phrases you can use in character to buy a few seconds, for example repeating your partner's line.
zh: 演到一半你脑子一片空白。说出三个可以在戏中争取几秒钟的短句，比如重复搭档的台词。

task: It is your turn in a one-word-at-a-time story, and you can't think of a word. Say what you could do or say so the story keeps going.
say: Once... upon... a... time... there... was... a...
zh: 轮到你在一人一词的故事里接词，但你想不出来。说说你可以怎么做或说什么，让故事继续下去。

task: You did the game wrong because you misunderstood the rules. Say sorry briefly out of character, check the rule, and ask to try again.
zh: 你理解错了规则，游戏做错了。出戏简短地道个歉，确认一下规则，并请求再试一次。

task: Your scene partner looks nervous before you go on stage together. Say two short things to help them relax.
zh: 上台前，你的搭档看起来很紧张。说两句简短的话帮对方放松。

task: After a scene, thank your partner and tell them one thing you learned from them.
zh: 一场戏结束后，感谢你的搭档，并告诉对方你从他身上学到的一点。

task: Introduce yourself to the class. Tell them you are still learning English and ask them, in a friendly way, to speak a bit more slowly with you.
zh: 向全班介绍自己。告诉大家你还在学英语，并友好地请大家和你说话时稍微慢一点。

task: In a scene, you said a word that doesn't make sense. Don't stop. Turn the mistake into part of the scene by giving a reason for it.
say: Wait, did you just say you want to eat the chair?
zh: 在戏里，你说了一个说不通的词。不要停，给它一个理由，把这个错误变成剧情的一部分。

task: Your scene partner is stuck and says the line below. Help them in character by giving a clear offer: who you are, or what you are doing.
zh: 搭档卡住了，说了下面这句话。不出戏地帮他：给一个清楚的设定，比如你是谁，或你们在做什么。

task: Your partner makes a mistake and corrects themselves. Don't fix it. Accept both ideas as true and build on them.
say: Welcome to my bakery... I mean, my library!
zh: 搭档说错了又自己改口。不要去纠正，把两个说法都当真，并在此基础上继续发展。

task: The teacher asks the question below after your scene. Answer honestly in two or three sentences: one thing that went well and one thing that was hard.
say: So, how did that scene feel for you?
zh: 一场戏结束后，老师问了下面这个问题。用两三句话诚实地回答：一件做得好的事，一件觉得难的事。

task: The teacher explains the rule below. You understand most of it but not one part. Check your understanding with a question that starts "So, just to check..."
say: In this round, if you hesitate, you're out, but you can come back in when the next person is out.
zh: 老师讲了下面这条规则。你大部分听懂了，但有一部分不明白。用 “So, just to check...” 开头提一个问题来确认。

task: You laughed in the middle of a scene and broke character. Say how you would get back into the scene, and give the exact line you would say next.
zh: 你在戏中笑场，出戏了。说说你会怎样重新进入状态，并给出你接下来要说的那句台词。

task: In a scene you are a wedding guest giving a speech, and your mind goes blank. Keep talking for thirty seconds with a simple plan: thank people, tell a short memory, and give a toast.
zh: 在一场戏里，你扮演在婚礼上致辞的宾客，突然脑子一片空白。用一个简单的思路继续讲三十秒：感谢大家，讲一段简短的回忆，然后举杯祝酒。

task: It is the last class of the course. Say goodbye to your classmates: thank them, say what you enjoyed most, and suggest meeting again.
zh: 这是课程的最后一节课。和同学们道别：感谢他们，说说你最喜欢什么，并提议以后再聚。
